VepiFind

In development

A job search app for Malawi that pulls listings from multiple sources, matches them to your profile and helps you apply with a stronger CV and cover letter.

  • Job listings from multiple sources in one feed
  • Personalised “best fit” recommendations
  • Cover letter drafts and CV improvements
  • Application tracking and interview prep

Process

How a project runs

The same four stages whether we’re building for you or for ourselves.

  1. 1

    Scope

    A call to understand the problem and constraints. You get a written plan, timeline and quote.

  2. 2

    Design

    Screens you can click through before code is written, so changes are cheap.

  3. 3

    Build

    Short cycles with a demo at the end of each one. You see progress every week.

  4. 4

    Launch & support

    Release, monitoring and a support plan. We stay on for the next version.
